_doc: Per-post 'Workshop next step' CTA (Sprint 13). For every published blog post, names ONE tool the post drives operator to, framed as 'Save your starting numbers and watch them weekly.' Stamped via scripts/inject-post-end-cta.mjs between the post-end-mark and the see-also block. EN+ES per post. The tool URL is taken verbatim — the inject script appends ?from=blog/<slug>&intent=watch so the tool can rehydrate baseline numbers from the originating article.

_status.review_required: All Sprint 13 CTA copy is drafted against the rubric (scripts/voice-refs/don-rubric.md). Review and adjust per-post copy before promoting to fail-CI.
_status.skipped: (none — every published article carries a paired CTA)

how-to-read-restaurant-google-search-con.tool_label_es: Abrir el mapa de palabras clave
how-to-read-restaurant-google-search-con.headline_en: Map what Search Console shows you.
how-to-read-restaurant-google-search-con.headline_es: Mapea lo que te muestra Search Console.
how-to-read-restaurant-google-search-con.body_en: The Local Keyword × Page Map sheet pulls Search Console queries into rows — keyword, neighborhood modifier, target URL, current rank, schema type. Print it, save it as CSV, or save it to your Workshop. Catches cannibalization and coverage gaps before they cost a booking.
how-to-read-restaurant-google-search-con.body_es: La hoja de Mapa de Palabras Clave × Página convierte las consultas de Search Console en filas — keyword, modificador de barrio, URL objetivo, posición actual, tipo de schema. Imprime, guarda como CSV o guarda en tu Taller. Atrapa canibalización y huecos de cobertura antes de que cuesten una reserva.

restaurant-photo-spec-sheet.body_en: The Photo Shot List sheet turns the spec into the day-of tool — dish × plate × garnish × props × channel target × aspect × priority × backup dish. Print it, bring it to set, tick each shot as it lands. The post tells you what to shoot; the sheet keeps the shoot from drifting.
restaurant-photo-spec-sheet.body_es: La hoja de Lista de Tomas convierte la especificación en la herramienta del día — plato × loza × decoración × props × canal destino × aspecto × prioridad × plato de respaldo. Imprime, llévala al set, tacha cada toma conforme aterriza. El artículo te dice qué tomar; la hoja evita que el shoot se desfase.

when-to-rebuild-your-restaurant-website.body_en: The Website Conversion Checklist runs 12 mobile checkpoints on your live site with priority ratings. If you score 11 or 12, the rebuild may be the wrong project — fix the one or two leaks instead. Print it, save it as CSV, or save it to your Workshop and re-run after each fix.
when-to-rebuild-your-restaurant-website.body_es: La Lista de Conversión del Sitio corre 12 chequeos móviles en tu sitio en vivo con prioridad. Si sacas 11 o 12, el rehacer puede ser el proyecto equivocado — arregla las una o dos fugas en su lugar. Imprime, guarda como CSV o guarda en tu Taller y vuelve a correrlo tras cada arreglo.
